title: [SORMAS2SORMAS] sending cases with related contacts
body:

### Situation Description

### Feature Description
Extend sormas 2 sormas feature to send/receive associated contacts with cases and apply pseudonymization and ownership options on all of them.

### Possible Alternatives

### Additional Information
Add option to select whether associated contacts should be shared or not
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
